part.name: Longitudinal pin-receiver lever body
part.description: Single-piece elongated mechanical lever or handle body with a rounded enlarged grip end, a rectangular shank, an axial blind cylindrical bore at the opposite end, an intersecting side pocket, and extensive edge transitions. The precise parent assembly and operating application are not identifiable from the supplied geometry alone.
part.symmetry_note: One connected solid. The shank and rounded end have locally repeated or paired edge treatments, but the complete part is not globally mirror-symmetric because of the side pocket, axial blind bore, stepped profile, and asymmetric end transitions.

semantic_orientation.description: The circular bore opening is interpreted as the functional front or connection end, while the enlarged rounded region is interpreted as the rear grip end. The broad z=-340 surface is treated as the semantic top. This orientation is functional rather than derived directly from camera labels.
